description: This file is a Makefile defining build configurations, variables, and functions for building the OPTEE-OS project within an embedded Linux build system, including target definitions, installation procedures, and dependency checks.

methods.name: Optee-os/Init
methods.description: Initializes build variables for OPTEE-OS with a specified variant.

methods.name: Build/Optee-os/Target
methods.description: Defines build target configuration for a specific variant.

methods.name: Build/Compile/Optee-os
methods.description: Compiles OPTEE-OS using make with cross-compilation settings.

methods.name: BuildPackage/Optee-os/Defaults
methods.description: Sets default build configuration for OPTEE-OS package.

methods.name: BuildPackage/Optee-os
methods.description: Builds the OPTEE-OS package for all specified variants.
